issues.jp_before: あんな人[ひと]{なんか|nanka-nante}{に|ni-target}謝[あやま]る必要[ひつよう]{は|wa-negative}ありません。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of the あんな人なんかに line just above it (laughed at).
issues.action: Changed the noun to 失礼な客 (rude customer) and updated the English and why to match.

issues.jp_before: 私[わたし]{なんか|nanka-nante}{と|to-with}結婚[けっこん]し{たら|tara-conditional}、後悔[こうかい]します{よ|yo-assertion}。
issues.problem: In と結婚する the と is reciprocal, not 'together with'.
issues.action: Changed the skill id to to-reciprocal.

issues.jp_before: こんな田舎[いなか]{なんか|nanka-nante}{に|ni-destination}、誰[だれ]{も|mo-total-negation}来[き]ません{よ|yo-assertion}。
issues.problem: へ is an equally natural destination with 来る but was not listed (line 8 of the same file does list it).

issues.jp_before: あんなけち{なんか|nanka-nante}{に|ni-source}お金[かね]{を|o-object}借[か]りたくない。
issues.problem: から is an equally natural source with 借りる but was not listed.

issues.jp_before: 雨[あめ]{の|no-possessive}日[ひ]{に|ni-time}マラソン大会[たいかい]{が|ga-existence}ある{なんて|nanka-nante}、聞[き]いていません。
issues.problem: The scenario (a marathon held on a rainy day as news) is odd and the English sounds strained.
issues.action: Rewrote it as 来週テストがあるなんて、聞いていませんよ。 / 'Nobody told me there's a test next week!' with f=1 and a new why.

issues.jp_before: もう今年[ことし]{が|ga-subject}終[お]わる{なんて|nanka-nante}、早[はや]いです{ね|ne-agreement}。
issues.problem: The English 'how fast it goes, doesn't it?' is unnatural.
issues.action: Changed the English to 'I can't believe the year is already ending. Time flies, doesn't it?'

issues.jp_before: (27 lines of the form AとかBとか) A{とか/など|toka-list}B{とか/など|toka-list}…
issues.problem: In the first, non-focus slot, など is listed as an alternative, but AなどBなど is marked. The fully natural alternative there is や (AやBなど / AやBとか), and it was missing.
issues.action: In every two-item list, changed the first slot's alternative from など to や ({とか/や|toka-list}). The final slot keeps {とか/など}.

issues.jp_before: 朝[あさ]{は|wa-topic}卵[たまご]{とか/など|toka-list}トースト{とか/など|toka-list}{を|o-object}食[た]べます。
issues.problem: 食べる was used four times in the file (the limit is three), and this line overlapped with the bread/rice-ball line.
issues.action: Rewrote it as 牛乳とかジュースとかを飲みます / 'In the morning I drink things like milk and juice.'

issues.jp_before: 母[はは]{に|ni-source}セーター{とか/など|toka-list}マフラー{とか/など|toka-list}{を|o-object}もらいました。
issues.problem: から is an equally natural source with もらう but was not listed.

issues.jp_before: 部屋[へや]{の|no-possessive}壁[かべ]{に|ni-destination}、写真[しゃしん]{とか/など|toka-list}ポスター{とか/など|toka-list}{を|o-object}はってあります。
issues.problem: With 〜てある, が is just as natural as を, but it was not listed.

issues.jp_before: 先生[せんせい]{は|wa-topic}、授業[じゅぎょう]{で|de-means}漫画[まんが]{とか/など|toka-list}アニメ{とか/など|toka-list}{を|o-object}使[つか]います。
